thread:
mike: quick follow-up on offload RFC: proposal: add an evict_token + deferred_free_window_ms on handoff so receivers can defer reclaim for a short window instead of rejecting. thoughts?

sara: interesting. prefer soft-defer over hard reject. main worry: memory blowup if abused. need quotas.

anand: proto-wise keep fields optional. router only sends token to hosts that advertise `defer_capable`. no extra RTT since token travels with handoff.

jia: receiver implementation: record token in a sharded token table with expiry, skip compactor reclaim for pages tied to active tokens. enforce max_tokens_per_shard.

sara: ops: add admission controls + metrics. `evict_token.outstanding`, `token.issued/rejected/expired`. also `defer_window_ms` histogram.

anand: router policy: `offload.defer_policy` = [USE_BEST_EFFORT, FAIL_FAST]. default USE_BEST_EFFORT -> if no defer nodes, fall back to normal handoff. include `retry_after_ms` hint on REJECT.

mike: rollout: proto + receiver GC + pool capability bit, router behind flag, canary. Dedicated must be opt-in. on-prem: pre-upgrade hook to backfill token meta.

jia: tests: unit for token expiry, integration where token expires and compactor reclaims, stress test for fragmentation vs tail latency. sara to own stress test.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: built runtime-offload:v2026.defer-token. canary scheduled prod-canary-01 2026-04-05T16:00Z.

mike: will open PR with proto and tests. :thumbsup:
